info.title: DomoAI Universal API
info.description: AI-powered video generation API for text-to-video, image-to-video, template-based video, talking avatar, video-to-video, file upload, and async task polling workflows.

post.description: Creates a new image-to-video task in DomoAI.

image.domoaiUri.description: A domoai_uri from the Upload File action.

prompt.description: Optional text prompt describing the video style or motion.

callbackUrl.description: Optional URL that DomoAI should notify when task status changes.
